DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は、どのお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What procedure are you here for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。後ろが混んでいるので、早く答えなければと思いましたが、内容を理解してから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混雑の圧力で急がず理解して相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not decided yet. The line behind me is crowded, so I felt I had to answer quickly, but I would like to understand the details before discussing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to understand and consult without rushing because of pressure from the crowd. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 急いでお決めになる必要はありません。今、ご確認されたいのはどの点ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You do not need to decide in a hurry. What would you like to check now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座の手続きについてです。申込用紙は取りましたが、まず内容を聞いてから申し込むか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙を取ったが説明後に申込を判断したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is about account procedures. I took an application form, but I would like to hear the details first and then decide whether to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you took a form but want to decide whether to apply after hearing the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談のご希望を伺ってから、必要な手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask what you want to discuss and then explain the necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では相談からお願いします。用紙は今は記入せずに持っていてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談を依頼し用紙を未記入で持っていてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like a consultation first. May I keep the form without filling it in for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a consultation and check whether you may keep the form blank for now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、説明を聞いてからで構いません。分からない点はその都度お尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can wait until you have heard the explanation. Please ask whenever something is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。後ろの列を気にして分かったふりをせず、分からない言葉はその場で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列を気にして分かったふりをせず聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I will not pretend to understand because I am worried about the line behind me; I will ask about unfamiliar words right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask rather than pretend to understand out of concern for the line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身のご希望を確認しながら進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us proceed while checking your own wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は申込むかをまだ決めず、説明の後に自分で考えます。必要なら持ち帰って検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に判断し必要なら持帰検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will leave the decision about applying open today and think for myself after the explanation. If necessary, I will take the information home to consider it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after the explanation and take it home to consider if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望でご案内します。それでは、こちらの相談席へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will assist you in accordance with that wish. Please come to this consultation seat. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が柔らかいパンを食べたいと言っています。この二つは、食感がどう違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族用の柔らかいパンを探し二商品の食感を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family says they would like soft bread. How do these two differ in texture?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for soft bread for your family and ask about the texture of two products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食感についてご説明できます。こちらは柔らかい食パン、隣は表面が硬めのパンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can explain their textures. This is soft sandwich bread, and the one next to it has a firmer crust.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食パンの方を選びます。家族が朝にそのまま食べたいと言っていたので、表面の硬い物は今日は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の朝用に柔らかい食パンを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will choose the sandwich bread. My family said they want to eat it as it is in the morning, so I will not buy the one with a hard crust today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose soft sandwich bread for your family’s breakfast. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厚さも違う物がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also have different slice thicknesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薄く切ってある食パンがいいです。どちらの袋を選べばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄切りの食パンの袋を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like thinly sliced sandwich bread. Which bag should I choose?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which bag contains thinly sliced sandwich bread. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは八枚入りです。ご希望に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one contains eight slices. Does it suit your wishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八枚入りを一袋お願いします。こちらの棚から取ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八枚入り一袋を指定し取る商品を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One bag of eight slices, please. May I take it from this shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify one bag of eight slices and confirm which product to take. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの八枚入りをかごへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please put this eight-slice bag in your basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食パンを一袋かごへ入れました。柔らかさを説明で聞けたので、これを買って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一袋かごに入れ説明を参考に購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put one bag of sandwich bread in my basket. Now that I have heard the explanation of its softness, I will buy this and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have put one bag in the basket and will buy it based on the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお会計へお進みください。ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to the checkout. Thank you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園のご利用についてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人二人と、三人で歌の練習をしたいです。大声や楽器は使いませんが、ここで練習してよいか先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人小声合唱の利用可否を事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to practice singing with two friends, three of us altogether. We will not sing loudly or use instruments, but I want to check beforehand whether we may practice here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult in advance about whether three people may practice singing quietly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用の決まりを確認します。どのくらいの時間をご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the rules of use. How long are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十分です。録音を流すのではなく、小さい声で歌詞の合わせ方を練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二十分録音楽器なしで歌詞合わせと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twenty minutes. Rather than playing a recording, we will quietly practice coordinating the lyrics.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will coordinate lyrics for twenty minutes without recordings or instruments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲への配慮が必要です。ベンチにいる方のすぐ横は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to be considerate of others. Please avoid the area right beside people sitting on benches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチから離れた所にしたいです。三人が通路に並ばずに練習できる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路をふさがず三人で練習できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We would like to be away from the benches. Is there somewhere three of us can practice without lining up across the path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a place where three people can practice without blocking the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空いている広場を使えるか、利用の決まりと合わせて確認します。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check whether you may use an empty open area, along with the rules. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし迷惑だと分かったら、声を上げて言い返さず、練習を止めます。続ける場所は別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迷惑なら反論せず停止し別場所相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we learn we are disturbing someone, we will stop practicing rather than raise our voices and argue back. We will ask separately about another place to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop without arguing if you cause a disturbance and ask about another place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わった後は、持ち物を残さないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not leave any belongings behind when you finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歌詞の紙はクリップで留めてあります。使える場所が分かるまでここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を留めて準備し利用場所の確認結果を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The lyric sheets are held together with a clip. We will wait here until we know which place we may use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the sheets are clipped and ready and that you will wait for confirmation of the permitted place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認して戻ります。まだ練習は始めずにお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check and come back. Please wait without starting practice yet. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かばんの中身が出かかっていますが、大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The contents of your bag are coming out. Is everything all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ファスナーが途中で開きました。ホームへ行く前に閉め直したいので、少し荷物を広げられる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開いた旅行かばんを閉じ直す場所を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The zipper opened partway. I would like to close it again before going to the platform, so please tell me somewhere I can spread out my belongings a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to close your opened travel bag again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札の横の空いたスペースへお越しください。出入口は空けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please come to the empty space beside the ticket gates. Let us keep the entrances and exits clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 改札の横ですね。かばんの中で服を詰め直すので、少しだけその場所を使わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札横の場所を確認し服を中で詰め直す間の利用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside the ticket gates, then. I will repack the clothes inside the bag, so please let me use that space briefly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the space beside the ticket gates and ask to use it while repacking clothes inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お急ぎの列車はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is there a train you are in a hurry to catch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の列車に乗る予定でしたが、ここで中身が落ちる方が困ります。一本見送って、閉まってから向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物散乱を避け一本見送ると判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I planned to take the next train, but it would be worse if the contents fell out here. I will let one train go and head over once the bag is closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to let one train go to avoid scattering your belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詰め直している間は、貴重品の入った小さいかばんを身に着けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: While repacking, please keep the small bag containing your valuables on you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい方は肩に掛けたままです。服がファスナーに挟まっていたので、少し奥へ押してから閉めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貴重品を肩掛けし挟まった服を内側へ直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The small one is still over my shoulder. Some clothes were caught in the zipper, so I will push them a little farther inside before closing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the valuables bag over your shoulder and will tuck the trapped clothes inward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 閉まりましたか。持ち上げる前に、左右もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is it closed? Please check both sides before lifting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一周閉まりました。両端から服が出ていません。荷物を全部しまえたので、次の発車を確認して移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 周囲を閉じた確認後に次発車へ向かうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is closed all the way around. No clothes are sticking out at either end. All my belongings are packed away, so I will check the next departure and move on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked that it is closed all around and will head for the next departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お忘れ物のないように。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make sure you have not forgotten anything. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は、どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can we help you with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 壊れた椅子を捨てたいです。車へ積んで来ましたが、市役所で受け取ってもらえるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車積載の壊れた椅子を役所で受け取るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to dispose of a broken chair. I brought it in my car, but can city hall accept it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether city hall will accept the broken chair loaded in your car. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、現物をお預かりしていません。処分方法は廃棄物の担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This information desk does not accept the actual items. Please consult the waste department about disposal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、椅子を建物へ運び込みません。木の椅子で座面が割れていますが、その情報を伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物へ運び込まず木製割れ座面と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will not bring the chair into the building. It is a wooden chair with a cracked seat; is that the information I should give?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not bring it into the building and explain it is wooden with a cracked seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 材質と大きさ、数量を伝えると相談しやすいです。測った寸法は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It helps to give the material, size and quantity. Do you know its measured dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 幅四十センチ、高さ八十センチで、一脚です。家で撮った写真もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 椅子一脚の幅高さと写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is forty centimeters wide and eighty centimeters high, and there is one chair. I also have a photo taken at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the width and height of the one chair and show the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当には、その情報で収集や持込みの受付方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use that information to ask the department how to arrange collection or drop-off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約が必要かと、費用がどのくらいかを担当へ聞きます。写真だけで先に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約と費用を確認したいと伝え写真での事前相談可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask whether a reservation is needed and how much it costs. Can I consult in advance with just the photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check reservations and costs, and ask whether advance consultation with a photo is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず写真と寸法を伝えて、必要な物を担当へ確認してください。この案内に連絡先があります。現物はご案内まで保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: First give the photo and dimensions and check with the department what is needed. The contact details are in this leaflet. Keep the chair until you receive instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 車に積んだ椅子は家へ戻します。担当の番号と、材質、寸法、一脚という内容をノートへ書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 椅子を自宅へ戻し連絡番号と現物情報を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the chair in the car back home. I wrote down the department’s number, the material, dimensions and the fact that it is one chair in my notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the chair home and have recorded the contact number and item information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご相談ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult the department, then. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お昼のお食事について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about lunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が弁当を持ってくると言っています。でも入院中の食事も出るので、受け取る前にどうすればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族弁当と入院食の重複を受取前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family says they will bring a packed meal. But I also receive hospital meals, so I would like to ask what to do before accepting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult before accepting a family packed meal that overlaps with your hospital meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お食事の指示と、持込みの扱いを確認します。ご家族はもうこちらへ向かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your dietary instructions and the rules for food brought in. Has your family already set off for the hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ家にいます。私が家の弁当を食べたいと言ったので、用意してくれることになりました。病院の食事は断っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家の弁当を希望し家族は未出発で入院食は断っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are still at home. I said I wanted a meal from home, so they agreed to prepare it. I have not declined the hospital meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you requested a homemade meal, your family has not left, and you have not declined the hospital meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認ができるまでは、作ったり運んだりするのを待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you ask them to wait before preparing or bringing it until we have checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今連絡します。家族には、食事のことを看護師に確認しているので、まだ持ってこないでほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ担当確認中なので調理運搬を待つ連絡をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact them now. I will tell them I am checking about meals with a nurse, so I would like them not to bring it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Contact your family to wait before preparing or transporting it because the staff are checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。病院のお食事で、召し上がりにくい物などはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Has there been anything in the hospital meals that is difficult to eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食べづらい物はありません。いつもの家の味が恋しくなって、家族に話しました。希望として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食べづらさではなく家の味を希望していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nothing is difficult to eat. I missed the usual taste of home and told my family. I would like to discuss it as a preference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the taste of home rather than having difficulty eating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望として伺います。担当が確認してから、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will take it as that preference. We will advise you after the staff member has checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に待ってもらえました。今ある食事の指示を変えず、案内を聞いてから、家族にもその内容を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族待機を伝え食事指示を維持し案内後家族へ伝達と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family agreed to wait. I will keep my current dietary instructions, listen to your guidance, and then relay it to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your family is waiting, you will maintain dietary instructions and tell them after receiving guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ確認してお返事します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the staff member and get back to you, then. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道を歩いている時のご相談ですね。何がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to consult us about something that happened while walking, is that right? What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車が水たまりを通って、私の服に水がかかりました。腹が立ちましたが、車を追いかけず、こちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車の水はねで服がぬれ追跡せず相談へ来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A car drove through a puddle and splashed water on my clothes. I was angry, but I came here without chasing the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a car splashed water onto your clothes and you came for help without chasing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: おけがはありますか。車が体へ接触したのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you injured? Did the car make contact with your body?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: けがはありません。車は体に触れていません。歩道側にいた私の上着とズボンがぬれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: けが接触なしと歩道側の衣服被害を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not injured. The car did not touch me. My jacket and trousers got wet while I was on the sidewalk side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain there was no injury or contact, and describe the damage to your clothes on the sidewalk side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 起きた場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the place and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この地図の曲がり角です。十五分ほど前で、道路に大きい水たまりがありました。車の番号は読み取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図の場所と十五分前と番号未読を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was at this corner on the map, about fifteen minutes ago. There was a large puddle in the road. I could not read the car’s number plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location on the map, say it was fifteen minutes ago and you could not read the plate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車について、覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything you remember about the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白い車だったことだけです。わざとかどうかは分かりません。ぬれた服は今この状態で、写真も一枚撮っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白車のみ記憶し故意不明と衣服写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only that it was white. I do not know whether it was intentional. My wet clothes are in this condition now, and I took one photo too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you only remember a white car, do not know if it was intentional, and show the clothing photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かった範囲でお話しください。対応について状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us what you do know. We will check the situation to determine how to respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白い車だったことと、番号が読めなかったことを伝えます。場所と時刻もメモに書いたので、写真と一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車の記憶と未読番号を区別し場所時刻メモと写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell you it was a white car and that I could not read the plate. I also wrote the place and time in a note, so please look at it with the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish what you remember about the car from the unread plate and show the place-and-time note and photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: メモと写真を担当に渡して確認してきます。こちらのお席でお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the note and photo to the staff member to check. Please wait in this seat. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会社宛ての応募書類を、お出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending application documents to a company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、二つの募集案内で会社の住所が違います。どちらへ送ればよいか、ここで確認できるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新旧募集案内の住所相違を伝え郵便窓口で確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the company addresses differ in two recruitment notices. Can I check here which one to send them to?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the address difference in old and new recruitment notices and ask whether the post office counter can check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 応募を受け付ける住所は、会社へ確認してください。二つの案内は、いつの物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the address accepting applications with the company. When are the two notices from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の案内は二年前に印刷した物で、携帯の案内は今週見つけました。会社名は同じですが、会社へはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二年前の紙と今週の案内と同じ会社名と未照会を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The paper notice was printed two years ago, and I found the notice on my phone this week. The company name is the same, but I have not asked the company yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain about the paper from two years ago, this week’s notice, the same company name and no inquiry yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい案内だけで決めず、今回の応募で使う住所を採用窓口へ確かめるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than deciding just from the newer notice, it would be best to check the address for this application with their recruitment contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社へ確認します。封筒には、前の紙を見て古い住所を書きました。まだ送らずに、書き直す準備をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ確認し旧住所を書いた封筒を未発送で整え直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check with the company. I wrote the old address on the envelope using the earlier paper. I want to prepare to rewrite it without sending it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check with the company and redo the envelope bearing the old address before sending it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付はまだしていませんので、この封筒をお持ち帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so you may take this envelope home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、封筒を戻してください。会社から返事が来るまで、書類はこの中へまとめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付前の封筒返却を頼み会社回答まで書類をまとめておくと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please return the envelope, then. I will keep the documents together inside until the company replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the envelope back before acceptance and say you will keep the documents together until the company responds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお返しします。住所が分かりましたら、宛名を整えてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your envelope back. Once you know the address, please prepare the addressee details and bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。会社へ二つの案内の日付と住所の違いを伝えます。確認した受付住所で封筒を作り直してから、また出しに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社に日付住所相違を示し確認済み受付住所で封筒を作り直して再来すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I will tell the company the dates and different addresses in the two notices. I will redo the envelope with the confirmed application address and come back to post it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the company about the dates and differing addresses, remake the envelope with the confirmed address and return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、会社へご確認のうえご準備ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check with the company and prepare it, then. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 定期預金について、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about your fixed-term deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の修理代が急に必要になりました。満期は半年先ですが、それまで待てないので途中で解約できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 急な修理費で半年先満期を待てず途中解約可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I suddenly need money for house repairs. Maturity is six months away, but I cannot wait until then, so I would like to ask whether I can close it early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about early closure because urgent repair costs mean you cannot wait for maturity six months away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの定期預金の内容を確認して、ご案内します。どちらの預金でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the details of your fixed-term deposit and advise you. Which deposit is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えの定期です。普通預金の残高だけでは修理代に足りません。まだ解約の申込書は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象定期控えと普通預金不足と未申込を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the deposit on this receipt. My ordinary savings balance alone is not enough for the repairs. I have not filled in a closure application yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the relevant deposit receipt, explain insufficient ordinary savings and no application yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な金額と希望の時期を、担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the staff member the amount you need and when you need it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週までに二十万円必要です。定期は三十万円なので、全部を解約するしかないか、一部でも相談できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週二十万円必要で三十万円定期の一部取扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need two hundred thousand yen by next week. The deposit is three hundred thousand yen, so I want to know whether I have to close all of it or can discuss withdrawing part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you need two hundred thousand yen next week and ask about partial handling of a three-hundred-thousand-yen deposit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部分的な取扱いができるかは、こちらの商品の条件を確認します。利息なども満期時と異なる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check this product’s conditions to see whether partial handling is possible. Interest and other terms may differ from those at maturity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一部だけなら残りの十万円を残せると助かります。利息と費用がどうなるか説明を聞いてから、金額を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十万円を残したい希望を示し利息費用説明後に解約額を決めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it can be partly closed, it would help to leave the remaining hundred thousand yen. I would like to hear how interest and fees would be affected before deciding the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave a hundred thousand yen and decide the closure amount after the explanation of interest and fees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 修理の支払期日も踏まえ、受付方法と手続きにかかる時間をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Taking the repair payment deadline into account, we will explain how to apply and how long processing takes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。来週の支払いに間に合うかを確認し、二十万円必要という状況で相談します。条件を聞いてから申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払期限と必要額を示し所要時間条件後に申込判断と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check whether it can be ready for next week’s payment and discuss my need for two hundred thousand yen. I will apply after hearing the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the payment deadline and required amount and say you will decide about applying after hearing processing times and conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。お手元の控えをお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the staff member, then. Please bring your receipt with you. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍ケースの扉で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the freezer case door?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。商品を取って扉を閉めようとしたら、かばんのひもが挟まりました。扉が最後まで閉まらないので、見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばんひもが冷凍ケース扉に挟まり閉まらないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I tried to close the door after taking a product, my bag strap got caught. The door will not close all the way, so please look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your bag strap is caught in the freezer case door and it will not close. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ひもを引かず、そのままお待ちください。どの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait as you are without pulling the strap. Which part is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右側のすき間の、このひもです。手や指は挟まっていません。痛いところもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 挟まった右側の位置を示し手指の挟まりと痛みはないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This strap in the gap on the right. My hand and fingers are not caught. Nothing hurts either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the caught strap on the right and say your hand and fingers are not trapped and you have no pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ひもが挟まっているのを確認しました。一度扉を開けて外しますので、かばんを支えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can see the strap is caught. I will open the door to free it; could you support your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下から支えます。中に重い本があるので、ひもだけ引くと落ちそうでした。支えている間に、扉を開けて外してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重い本の入ったかばんを底から支え店員へ開扉とひも外しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will support it from underneath. There are heavy books inside, so it looked as if it would fall if I pulled only the strap. Could you open the door and free it while I hold the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Support the bag of heavy books from underneath and ask the clerk to open the door and free the strap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 扉を開けて、ひもを外せました。お手元のかばんをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I opened the door and freed the strap. Please check the bag you are holding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ひもは切れていません。本も入ったままです。長い部分をかばんの口へまとめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ひもと内容物の状態を確認し長いひもをまとめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. The strap is not broken. The books are still inside too. I will gather the long section at the opening of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the strap and contents and say you will gather up the long strap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 扉も閉まりました。商品は床へ落ちていませんので、お買い物を続けていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The door is closed too. No products fell on the floor, so you may continue shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お手数をおかけしました。ひもをまとめたので、ケースから少し離れて持ちます。外していただいて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手間をかけたと謝りひもをまとめケースから離して持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sorry for the trouble. I have gathered up the strap, so I will carry the bag a little away from the case. It was a great help to have you free it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apologize for the trouble and say you have gathered the strap and will keep the bag away from the case. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせくださってありがとうございます。それでは、お荷物にも気を付けてお買い物をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. Please continue shopping, taking care of your belongings too.
